title: Backup & Restore
description: Manage disaster-recovery snapshots of the control plane.

list.label: Backups
list.deleteDescription: Permanently delete "{{filename}}"? This cannot be undone.

schedule.title: Automated Backup Schedule
schedule.description: Configure recurring backups. The engine runs the schedule; passphrase is derived from the instance secret.
schedule.retentionDescription: Backups older than this are automatically pruned.
schedule.dualControlDescription: When enabled, a restore started from THIS CONSOLE must be approved by a second, distinct administrator before it runs. Turning it off is recorded and takes effect one hour later — the gate cannot be removed in the same sitting as the restore it guards; re-enabling cancels a pending removal. It does not cover `olivares dr restore` on the host, which replaces an estate outside this gate and records a declared operator instead (Postgres estates restore only that way). Leave off for a solo operator.
schedule.dualControlDisarmPending: Removal requested — recorded, and it takes effect {{when}}. Until then a restore still needs a second administrator. Re-enable to cancel.

trigger.title: Create Backup
trigger.description: Create an encrypted snapshot of the entire control plane.
trigger.passphraseDescription: Used to encrypt the backup bundle.

pending.title: Restores awaiting approval (dual-control)
pending.dialogDescription: You are approving a restore requested by {{initiator}}. You must be a different administrator than the requester.
pending.passphraseDescription: Enter the passphrase the backup was created with.
pending.confirmDescription: This will overwrite all current data with the backup contents once verified. This operation cannot be undone.

restore.title: Restore from Backup
restore.description: Upload a .drbundle file to restore the control plane state.
restore.confirmDescription: This will overwrite all current data with the backup contents. This operation cannot be undone.
restore.awaitingDescription: Dual-control is enabled. This restore will not run until a different administrator approves it and supplies the passphrase from the Backups tab.
restore.passphraseDescription: Enter the passphrase used when this backup was created.

inspect.title: Backup detail
inspect.description: Decoded manifest of the sealed bundle — exactly what a restore would bring back.
inspect.loadFailed: Failed to load the backup detail.

backup.title: No backup snapshots created yet
backup.description: Create an encrypted backup from this console on SQLite; for PostgreSQL, create the bundle with the DR CLI in the configured backup directory.
